mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Sugar, sugary, produced from or relating to the sugar cane.
E.
इक्षु sugar cane, अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
A carrier of sugar canes.
E.
ईक्ष, and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Carrying sugar canes.
E.
इक्षु, and भार a load, ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Of the family of IKṢVĀKU.
E.
ईक्षाकु, and अञ् affix, the final rejected.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Of the family of IKṢVĀKU.
E.
ईक्ष्वाकु, and अण् aff.
